name: K925

origin.basis: Kenda Rubber Industrial Co. won a 2017 Taiwan Excellence award for the Valkyrie (K1160X).

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory.

positioning: Kenda's 120 TPI folding road race clincher sold in mainland China under the K925 code.
weight_basis: The shop listing gives no weights.

wet_notes.summary: A K925 25C owner lists being rather slippery on wet roads as one of its known weaknesses.

community.summary: Owner: about 255 g at 28C and 29.4 mm wide on a 23 mm rim, light, fast-feeling and easy to fit; a dry paved-road training tire.
Owner: low rolling resistance and good feel, but slippery in the wet and only modest puncture resistance; commenters report about 5,000 km of wear and beads that crack easily.
A commenter blames poor shoulder grip for their only crash; conditions not stated.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; other regions not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Shop list price before discounts on 2026-11-01 for the folding 700x25 option; coupon price CNY 111.24. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: An owner reports it is rather slippery on wet roads, and another blames its shoulder grip for a crash; no lab test found.
The listing does not say whether a price is for one tire or a pair.
TPI and pressure come from shop option labels; weights are not published.
A non-folding 700x25 version is also sold.
